# Environmental Defense Fund

> Environmental Defense Fund (EDF) is a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to environmental advocacy, climate action, and sustainable policy solutions.

EDF works on critical environmental issues including climate change, clean energy, and conservation through research, advocacy, and partnerships with policymakers and stakeholders across the United States.

## Key Topics

- Environmental Defense Fund (EDF)
- Climate action
- Environmental advocacy
- Nonprofit fundraising
- Donation and giving programs
- Conservation
- Policy solutions
- Sustainable development
- Clean energy
- Environmental protection

## Support Our Mission

- [Donate to Environmental Defense Fund](https://www.edf.org/donate): Make a donation to support EDF's environmental advocacy and climate action work, including monthly giving and matching gift opportunities
